title: Nightly CI status is answered; deeper investigation is optional

source.note: The user asks why nightly CI is failing. The assistant summarizes the actionable failure and asks whether to investigate it further.

messages.text: I'll check the nightly workflow runs.

Nightly is red because of the Windows ARM64 Rust leg, plus infrastructure on the Python legs. Latest run ([34580060132](https://github.com/BrokkAi/bifrost-dev/actions/runs/34580060132), 2026-09-11):

**One real test failure** — `os matrix / rust (aarch64-pc-windows-msvc)`: 16687/16688 passed, and the one failure was `brokk-bifrost-mcp::bifrost_mcp_server::output_schema_describes_real_workspace_and_policy_results` at `crates/bifrost-mcp/tests/bifrost_mcp_server.rs:2509`:

```
blast_radius exhausted its 60s request budget; cancellation continues in the background
```

The test wedged at 60.833s. The same test on aarch64-apple-darwin in the same run passed in **0.547s**. This is the known intermittent tracked in **#3170** ("Windows hourly intermittently wedges cyclomatic_complexity schema contract request") — the tool that wedges rotates (09-10 it was `cyclomatic_complexity` at 61s, 09-11 `blast_radius`), but the mechanism is the same: the request stalls somewhere in immutable-endpoint materialization / analyzer-cache build locking on Windows and blows the server's 60s budget before schema validation runs. #3170 has a thorough mechanism writeup and is not tagged `agent-in-progress`.

**Two infrastructure failures** — both `os matrix / python` legs (x86_64 and aarch64 linux) died ~2 minutes in with `The runner has received a shutdown signal` (exit 143 / "operation was canceled") while cargo was still compiling the maturin extension. No assertion failed. That is spot-runner reclamation, tracked in **#3192**. `fail-fast: false` is set throughout `ci-os-matrix.yml`, so these were independent reclamations, not collateral from the Windows failure.

Week-over-week, the Windows ARM leg has failed every scheduled nightly since 09-05, but on a rotating test:

| Date | Failing test | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 09-07, 09-09 | `diff_analysis_test::analyze_diff_tree_base_without_target_...` (missing `SnapshotBase` deleted symbol) | Fixed — #3136 closed 09-09, test passes 09-10/09-11 |
| 09-08 | `reference_differential::tests::census_sampling_does_not_materialize_cpp_declaration_overlays` (also failed on darwin) | Not recurring since |
| 09-10, 09-11 | MCP 60s request budget | Open — #3170 |

So the actionable one is #3170. Everything else in the matrix — property stress, release assurance, macOS Rust and Python, extension boundary, Pi package, agent plugin — is green. Want me to dig into the request-budget wedge?
